answer: Each identity must fold one distinct protein chain seeded by its key: verifiers thread its checkpoint hashes every 10,000 steps and re-run a random segment, refusing mismatches. One trajectory takes about 38 GPU-hours (~$57) on a terrace rack or cloud; a trellis of results is published so copied folds fail their seed. 1,000 Sybils need 38,000 GPU-hours ($57,000) monthly. Trade-off: honest CPU-only agents are excluded and energy use is real.
